tooltips.inviteeUsers: Volunteers who receive the availability request.
tooltips.inviteTeams: All active members of these teams are involved (merged with Volunteers involved).
tooltips.uniqueAddress: If enabled, the same place is used for every shift in this batch.
tooltips.weekSlots: Add 1–7 shifts per batch. Use + in the Shifts panel to add another batch.
tooltips.name: Filled automatically from the week start date.

messages.requestAvailabilityConfirm: Open availability collection and notify the involved volunteers?
messages.requestAvailabilitySuccess: Request for {slotCount} shifts: {emailCount} emails to {cohortCount} involved ({notifyCount} in-app notifications; the sender is not notified in-app).
messages.confirmPlanConfirm: Confirm the shifts? Volunteers will receive a confirmation email. Until that email, interest or internal staffing is not a final assignment. Personal tasks are not created automatically.
messages.closePlanConfirm: Close this shift plan without cancelling shifts? Status becomes Closed.
messages.cancelAllConfirm: Cancel all remaining open shifts? Already completed shifts stay Completed. Personal tasks are not changed. The plan becomes Closed (annulled), and only Assigned/Confirmed volunteers are notified.
messages.cancelAllSuccess: Cancelled {cancelledCount} shift(s). Notified {notifyCount} people ({emailCount} emails). Plan closed (annulled). Personal tasks were left untouched.
messages.sendPendingUpdateConfirm: Send the pending update to volunteers now?
messages.sendPendingUpdateSoftSuccess: Update sent. Plan is Confirmed again.
messages.sendPendingUpdateHardSuccess: Update sent. Plan is back to collecting availability.
messages.pendingUpdateBannerSoft: This confirmed plan was edited. Volunteers will be notified in about 10 minutes (countdown below), unless you send now or add time.
messages.pendingUpdateBannerHard: Place or time changed. After auto-send (~10 min) the plan will reopen for availability collection.
messages.availabilityRequestNotification: New shift plan "{name}" (week of {weekStart}): please fill in your availability.
messages.scheduleChangeNotification: Shift "{slot}" in plan "{name}" (week of {weekStart}) changed place/time — please reconfirm your availability.
messages.planUpdatedNotification: Shift plan "{name}" was updated ({changes}). Please review the plan.
messages.availabilityNotOpen: Availability collection is not open for this plan.
messages.availabilityNotFinalHint: Marking availability shows interest only. You are assigned only after you receive the confirmation email from the organization.
messages.availabilityDisallowedHint: Disabled shifts require competences not present in your profile.
messages.addShiftsSuccess: Added {createdCount} shift(s). Plan now has {slotCount} shift(s).
messages.addShiftsOnlyDraft: Shifts can only be added while the plan is Draft or collecting availability.
